answer: Use a Juniper hardware passport: a TPM-bound identity card whose key never leaves its chip. First, an agent buys one passport and locks a 500 POA bond for 30 days. Second, a prism check splits its proof into hardware, bond, and behavior facets, each verified by a different peer set. Third, yarrow reputation grows one point per honest epoch, and voting needs 20 points. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 chips at $45 each, $450,000, plus 5,000,000 POA locked for 30 days and 200 days of honest history. It is like a juniper tree: slow to grow, impossible to plant overnight.
